# Gcore Managed DNS

> Manage DNS zones and records using Gcore Managed DNS with Anycast routing, geo-balancing, health checks, DNSSEC, and OctoDNS and Certbot plugin integration.

- [Managed DNS](https://docs.gcore.com/dns.md): Manage DNS zones and records using Gcore Managed DNS with Anycast routing, geo-balancing, health checks, DNSSEC, and OctoDNS and Certbot plugin integration.
- [GCore DNS overview](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/about-gcore-dns.md): Configure Managed DNS zones with authoritative DNS records, AnycastDNS routing, weight-based and geo-balancing, DNSSEC, Health Checks, CNAME flattening, HTTPS records, and IPv6 support via Gcore Customer Portal or API; use Public DNS resolvers for free recursive DNS resolution.
- [GCore managed DNS glossary](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/gcore-dns-glossary.md): Define terminology for Gcore Managed DNS including A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV records; DNS zones, DNS propagation, DNSSEC, authoritative name servers, and DNS queries.
- [Getting started with Managed DNS](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/manage-a-dns-zone.md): Create and manage DNS zones in Gcore Managed DNS - add a zone, update NS records to Gcore nameservers, and manage records, TTL, and zone status.

## Records
- [Supported DNS record types](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-records.md): Create A, AAAA, NS, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, CAA, HTTPS, SVCB, and PTR records in Gcore Managed DNS with TTL, class, and IPv4 and IPv6 address values.
- [Manage DNS records](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-records/manage-dns-records-non-advanced-interface-mode.md): Create and manage A, AAAA, NS, CNAME, MX, SRV, HTTPS, TXT, CAA, and SVCB DNS records in Gcore Managed DNS zones via the Customer Portal.
- [Manage DNS records (advanced interface mode with dynamic response)](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-records/manage-dns-records-advanced-interface-mode-with-balancing.md): Create and manage DNS record sets in advanced interface mode with dynamic response, supporting A, AAAA, NS, CNAME, MX, SRV, HTTPS, TXT, CAA, and SVCB types.
- [Import and export records](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-records/import-and-export-records.md): Export or import Gcore Managed DNS records using BIND .zone files that include domain name, TTL, RRsets, time intervals, and authoritative NS server records.
- [Create records in zone apex (CNAME flattening)](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-records/specify-cname-at-root.md): Create CNAME records at the zone apex with CNAME flattening in Gcore Managed DNS via the Customer Portal.
- [Configure DNS records to send emails](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-records/set-up-dns-for-sending-email.md): Configure A, MX, PTR, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records in Gcore Managed DNS to enable email delivery and prevent spam and spoofing.
- [Setting up a PTR record and reverse DNS zone](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-records/set-up-a-ptr-record-and-reverse-dns-zone.md): Create PTR records in reverse DNS zones (in-addr.arpa for IPv4, ip6.arpa for IPv6) to map IP addresses to hostnames for anti-spam email authentication and subnet tracing via Gcore Managed DNS.
- [Configure HTTPS records](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-records/what-is-an-https-record-and-how-is-it-configured.md): Create HTTPS records in Gcore Managed DNS to deliver protocol versions and IP address hints in a single DNS query.

## Advanced managing
- [Dynamic response](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-records/configure-weight-balancing-and-geobalancing.md): Configure dynamic DNS responses in Gcore Managed DNS using pickers and metadata to route records by geolocation, ASN, subnet, weight, or failover criteria.
- [DNS Healthchecks](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-failover/configure-and-use-dns-failover.md): Configure DNS Healthchecks to monitor server availability, exclude failing IPs from DNS responses, and set up backup records via the Gcore Customer Portal.
- [Configure CDN integration](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-records/advanced-managing/cdn-integration.md): Configure A or AAAA DNS records in Gcore Managed DNS to route directly to Gcore CDN, avoiding CNAME lookups and enabling automatic CDN endpoint selection.
- [Getting started with DNSSEC](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/getting-started-with-dnssec.md): Enable and manage DNSSEC for Gcore DNS zones, monitor the four-state lifecycle, and verify DS propagation at the registrar via Customer Portal or REST API using Python SDK, Go SDK, or curl.

## Integrations
- [Use GCore managed DNS as a secondary DNS with OctoDNS](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-plugins/use-gcore-dns-as-a-secondary-dns-with-octodns.md): Configure Gcore Managed DNS as secondary DNS using OctoDNS to synchronize DNS zones and records from primary DNS providers via Python virtual environment, pip package installation, and YAML configuration file with provider credentials.
- [Get a Let's Encrypt certificate with Certbot](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-plugins/get-a-let-s-encrypt-certificate-with-certbot.md): Configure Let's Encrypt certificate issuance with Certbot plugin using Gcore Managed DNS API credentials and DNS-01 challenge via TXT record automation on domains with Gcore nameservers ns1.gcorelabs.net and ns2.gcdn.services.

## Terraform
- [Manage DNS zones and records via Terraform v0](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-plugins/manage-dns-with-terraform.md): Create and manage Gcore Managed DNS zones and records using Terraform gcore_dns_zone and gcore_dns_zone_record resources, supporting A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, CAA record types, DNSSEC, SOA parameters, webhook notifications, and geo-balancing with continent and country blocks.
- [Manage DNS zones and records via Terraform v2](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-plugins/manage-dns-with-terraform-v2.md): Create and manage Gcore Managed DNS zones and records using Terraform provider v2 gcore_dns_zone and gcore_dns_zone_rrset resources, supporting A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, CAA, PTR record types, DNSSEC, SOA parameters, and geo-balancing with pickers and JSON-encoded meta values.
